title: Vegan Melon Salad
description: A refreshing summer salad made with juicy melon, a hint of garlic, and a touch of velvety goodness.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine diced melon and minced garlic.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together vegan cream and a pinch of salt.
3. Pour the creamy mixture over the melon mixture and toss to coat.
4. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
